## V. Prayer

WHEREFORE, plaintiff respectfully prays that the Court:

- (a) order defendants to produce the originals of all receipts comprising Exhibit "5", and the receipt booklets, stubs or duplicates from which they came, before the Branch Clerk of Court on a date certain;
- (b) grant plaintiff leave to have those originals examined, non-destructively, by the PNP Forensic Group Questioned Document Examination Division or by a court-approved private questioned-documents examiner, under the custody and chain-of-custody terms stated above, at plaintiff's cost;
- (c) direct that no sampling or destructive test be done except as authorized under prayer (c-1) or by further leave of Court;
- (c-1) by separate order, and as a matter of urgency, grant plaintiff leave to have micro-samples taken from up to ten designated receipts and from control entries for ink comparison, ink identification and GC-MS relative ink-age analysis by Riley, Welch, LaPorte & Associates, Aginsky Forensic Document Dating Laboratory, Inc., or another laboratory the Court approves, under the sampling, custody and observation terms in ¶17-A, at plaintiff's cost;
- (d) direct the taking or identification of handwriting standards as the Court finds proper; and
- (e) grant other just relief.

Mercedes, Camarines Norte, ____ __________ 2026.

[Counsel for Plaintiff — UNSIGNED DRAFT]
